description: SGLang inference engine — RadixAttention prefix caching, constrained/structured generation (JSON schema + regex), fastest-in-class latency on structured outputs. Docker-compose scaffold with sglang.launch_server and an OpenAI-compatible client. For agent products that depend on JSON/tool-call validity and heavy prefix-sharing across requests.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pick SGLang when the workload is agentic/tool-calling/JSON-schema-heavy — RadixAttention reuses prefix KV across requests with shared system prompts, and the constrained decoder guarantees valid JSON without re-sampling. For raw throughput on free-form text, vLLM is comparable; for smaller footprints, ollama; for HF ecosystem, tgi.
firstSteps: docker compose up -d (GPU host) OR `bash launch.sh` (bare-metal Python install)
python -m src.client — exercises plain + JSON-schema-constrained generation
gotchas: SGLang ships a torch version pinned inside the Docker image. Don't bind-mount a host Python env — runtime mismatches crash the CUDA kernels.
RadixAttention's win comes from shared prefixes. If every request has a unique system prompt, SGLang's advantage over vLLM shrinks to nil.
Constrained generation requires `response_format={'type': 'json_schema', 'schema': {...}}` on the request. Omit that and you get plain unconstrained output.
Default port is 30000 (not 8000). Make sure LB/firewall rules match.
--mem-fraction-static above 0.90 can OOM when KV cache grows; 0.85 is the safe default on mixed workloads.
Gated HF models require HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN plus license acceptance on the Hub.
